PicPac local vision resources — integration notes

Pinned SDK: @mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.21 (published non-prerelease).
The npm tarball SHA-512 was checked against registry metadata before extraction.
The module, both WASM loaders/binaries and two models are self-hosted here.
No image upload or Google service call is needed for this inference pipeline.
Serve over HTTP(S); do not run from a file:// URL.

INITIALIZATION (ES module)

const assetBase = new URL('./assets/mediapipe/', document.baseURI);
const { FilesetResolver, ImageSegmenter, FaceDetector } =
  await import(new URL('vision_bundle.mjs', assetBase).href);
const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(new URL('wasm', assetBase).href);

const segmenter = await ImageSegmenter.createFromOptions(vision, {
  baseOptions: {
    modelAssetPath: new URL('selfie_segmenter.tflite', assetBase).href,
    delegate: 'CPU'
  },
  runningMode: 'IMAGE',
  outputConfidenceMasks: true,
  outputCategoryMask: false
});

const labels = segmenter.getLabels();
const personIndex = labels.findIndex(label =>
  /^(selfie|person)$/i.test(label.trim()));
if (personIndex < 0) throw new Error('Unrecognized segmentation model labels');

let personMask;
segmenter.segment(decodedImageOrCanvas, result => {
  const mask = result.confidenceMasks?.[personIndex];
  if (!mask) throw new Error('Missing person confidence mask');
  personMask = {
    width: mask.width,
    height: mask.height,
    values: mask.getAsFloat32Array().slice()
  };
});

CONFIDENCE INDEX — IMPORTANT

This exact downloaded SelfieSegmenter float16/1 model contains an embedded
labels.txt with one line: "selfie". Its tensor shape is [1,256,256,1].
For these pinned resources the expected getLabels() result is ["selfie"] and
confidenceMasks[0] is the person mask. Use getLabels() to assert this at runtime.
This asset task verified the metadata and implementation, not browser inference.

Do NOT use confidenceMasks[1] on this model. The generalized overview describing
background=0/person=1 does not describe this model's single-channel confidence
output. The v0.10.21 calculator treats a one-channel model as foreground:
categoryMask is 0 for foreground and 255 for unlabelled background (CPU code),
not a two-channel probability array. Prefer the float confidence mask.

The model consumes RGB [1,256,256,3], normalized to [0,1]. MediaPipe performs
input preprocessing. Pass the decoded source image/canvas at its native aspect
ratio; do not first distort it to 256x256. Use the returned mask width/height.
Callback mask memory is valid only inside the callback. Copy it if retained.
If using segment(image) without callback, call result.close() after use.
Call segmenter.close() when disposing the instance.

COMPOSITING

The confidence value represents the foreground, so use it as source alpha
(optionally a conservative smooth threshold after visual QA). Composite original
RGB over white. Do not invert the mask and do not modify facial features.
The model is not pixel-perfect, especially at hair, fingers and weak contrast.
Keep the original and provide before/after review plus a route to retake/manual
review. This model does not validate a passport or guarantee agency acceptance.

FACE DETECTION (reuse the same vision FilesetResolver result)

const detector = await FaceDetector.createFromOptions(vision, {
  baseOptions: {
    modelAssetPath: new URL('face_detector.tflite', assetBase).href,
    delegate: 'CPU'
  },
  runningMode: 'IMAGE',
  minDetectionConfidence: 0.5,
  minSuppressionThreshold: 0.3
});
const { detections } = detector.detect(decodedImageOrCanvas);
const oneFaceDetected = detections.length === 1;
if (oneFaceDetected) {
  const face = detections[0];
  const score = face.categories[0]?.score;
  const box = face.boundingBox;
  // box.originX, box.originY, box.width, box.height are source-image pixels.
  // face.keypoints contains six points normalized to image width/height.
}

BlazeFace short_range float16/1 input is RGB [1,128,128,3], float [-1,1].
Raw outputs: regressors [1,896,16], classificators [1,896,1]. MediaPipe performs
normalization and postprocessing; applications use detections, not raw tensors.
score is detection confidence, not identity confidence or document acceptance.
The model is designed for prominent, close faces (about 2 m or nearer). A result
with one detection means one detectable face; it cannot prove no obscured/small
face exists. The bounding box is a face box, not the top-of-hair/chin geometry
required for a legally accurate document crop.

LOADING / LICENSE

FilesetResolver chooses the SIMD or no-SIMD runtime for the current browser.
The two WASM binaries are about 9.6 MB each uncompressed; normally only one is
loaded. Lazy-load on entry to the feature, reuse task instances, and display a
loading/error state. Do not substitute a CDN/latest path at runtime.
CPU avoids requiring the GPU delegate; browser rendering support is still needed.

SDK and both models are Apache-2.0. LICENSE is the official license text from
the v0.10.21 MediaPipe repository. Model cards explicitly state Apache-2.0 on
page 1; they are retained as MODEL_CARD.pdf and FACE_MODEL_CARD.pdf. Preserve
license and upstream copyright notices in redistribution. Model intended-use
limitations are documented by their cards; neither model performs identity
recognition. See SOURCES.json for exact URLs and SHA-256 hashes.
